note: Han Zheng was correctly ranked first at 35%. Airport-greeter forecasts should emphasize protocol fit: the vice president can be the senior ceremonial representative even when the premier and foreign minister are more prominent in substantive talks.

The Japan Rugby Football Union carried only 15%. Conduct sanctions against a national coach are primarily an employer and home-federation responsibility even when the alleged incident occurs on an overseas tour.

Koh Phangan was present but underweighted at 10%. Nominee-company land crackdowns extend beyond the largest tourism hubs, so nearby high-foreign-ownership islands deserve more mass than a simple prominence prior gives them.

Becerra was included at 13% but recent evidence of his surge was underweighted. For near-term poll-top questions, current movement and name recognition can outweigh an older polling leader, and 53% on Hilton was too concentrated.

Kenneth Iwamasa was omitted. Sentencing-order forecasts must track every defendant's plea, cooperation and scheduled hearing; the most culpable or prominent defendant is not necessarily sentenced last.
Inter Milan resolved correctly at 89%. The late team-strength and matchup assessment supported a concentrated forecast without eliminating Lazio's upset path.
